benchmark_name: Veritas Phase 4 Evidence-Based Claim Verification Comprehensive Benchmark
description: Standardized benchmark evaluating stance classification, multi-source evidence aggregation, contradiction detection, duplicate handling, and absence-of-evidence safety guardrails.
epistemic_principles: Never equate missing evidence with proof of falsity (absence of evidence is not evidence of absence).
Never represent uncalibrated heuristic scores as frequentist or Bayesian probabilities.
Require independent multi-domain corroboration before assigning high verification confidence.
Discount syndicated duplicates to prevent artificial consensus.

cases.claim_text: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope detected atmospheric water vapor on exoplanet WASP-96b.

evidence_items.text: NASA officially confirmed that the James Webb Space Telescope has detected distinct atmospheric water vapor signatures in the transmission spectrum of WASP-96b.
Spectroscopic observations released by the Space Telescope Science Institute verified the presence of clear water vapor absorption lines on WASP-96b.
Astronomers published independent corroboration showing atmospheric water molecules detected by Webb's NIRISS instrument on WASP-96b.

cases.claim_text: Drinking boiling seawater cures COVID-19 and neutralizes viral replication.

evidence_items.text: The World Health Organization confirmed that claims suggesting drinking seawater cures COVID-19 are dangerous medical misinformation with zero scientific basis.
Medical experts from the Centers for Disease Control debunked the viral boiling seawater remedy, warning that hypertonic ingestion causes severe dehydration and organ damage.
Fact-checking investigations disproved viral social media claims alleging boiling salt water kills coronaviruses, designating the claim as completely false.

cases.claim_text: National quarterly manufacturing output expanded by 4.2 percent in Q3 2026.

evidence_items.text: Department of Commerce provisional estimates confirmed that manufacturing production expanded robustly by 4.2 percent during the third quarter.
The Federal Reserve Board's revised industrial production index contradicted early estimates, finding manufacturing output fell by 0.6 percent rather than growing.
Economists at Reuters reported that conflicting statistical methodologies between Commerce and Federal Reserve data have produced irreconcilable Q3 manufacturing figures.

cases.claim_text: The United Nations passed a binding resolution declaring lunar water extraction illegal under international maritime law.

Legal scholars at Reuters verified that no UN resolution has banned water extraction on the moon, labeling the viral claim as false.
